files once per cache in a [blob store shared across
repos](https://huggingface.co/docs/huggingface_hub/guides/manage-cache#shared-blobs-across-repos)
(`<cache>/blobs/<hash prefix>/<hash>`), and the repo's `blobs/<etag>`
becomes a relative symlink to it. A model and its external data in one
snapshot can then resolve into different folders (for example
`blobs/28/…` and `blobs/d4/…`, or one in the repo's `blobs/` and one in
the shared store). The symlink fallback from #27374 only accepts
external data next to the resolved model, so models with external data
loaded from a default `hf_hub_download` path fail with `External data
path escapes model directory`. This PR teaches both external data
validators about the shared store without trusting anything outside the
cache's blob folders.

### Summary of Changes

#### Validation (`onnxruntime/core/framework/tensorprotoutils.cc`)

New Pass 3 in `ValidateExternalDataPath`, reached only when the model is
a symlink and Passes 1–2 fail. If the canonical model directory is in a
snapshot of a cache repo (`<cache>/<type>s--<repo
id>/snapshots/<revision>/…`, also from a subfolder such as `onnx/`),
external data is accepted when:

1. its path does not leave the model directory before symlinks are
resolved (no `..` escape), and
2. both the model and the external data resolve to files under the blob
stores of that cache: the repo's `blobs/` folder or the cache-wide
`blobs/` folder.

`ValidateOpenedExternalDataPath` applies the same blob-store check to
the canonical path of the opened file, so the opened-file validation
from #33063 also covers the new case. The cost is one extra
canonicalization, and only after the existing passes fail.

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `onnxruntime/core/framework/tensorprotoutils.cc` | Add
`IsInHuggingFaceCacheBlobStores` and use it in both validators. |
| `onnxruntime/test/framework/tensorutils_test.cc` |
`HuggingFaceCachePathValidationTest`: 11 tests on a cache built like
`huggingface_hub` does, with two-hop relative symlinks (6 accepted
layouts, 5 rejected). |
| `onnxruntime/test/python/onnxruntime_test_python_symlink_data.py` |
End-to-end `InferenceSession` test for the shared store and for a mixed
repo-local/shared layout. |

#### Security notes

- Paths are compared in canonical form. A canonical path has no
symlinks, so a file whose canonical path is under `<cache>/blobs` is
stored in that real folder. If a `blobs/` folder is itself a symlink or
junction, nothing matches (`huggingface_hub` also never uses a symlinked
`blobs/` folder as the shared store).
- The model itself must resolve into the blob stores. This rejects
symlinked models that point outside the cache, and `symlink/..` tricks
in the model path.
- The no-`..` requirement keeps a malicious model from reaching other
cached repos' files. In a real cache, the entries of a snapshot folder
are symlinks that `huggingface_hub` creates to files of the same repo.
- Someone who can write into the cache root gains nothing new. With the
existing Pass 2 (for example ORT 1.31.1), they can already make a model
read any blob by putting the model file in the same shard folder
(verified). `huggingface_hub` also gives the store and shard folders the
same permissions as the cache root.
- Unchanged: empty, absolute, and in-memory-tag locations are still
rejected before any fallback, and Passes 1–2 behave as before.

#### Comparison with #33974

#33974 targets the same issue. It also checks the
`.huggingface-shared-blobs` marker (version `1`) and blob names (hex,
40/64 characters, 2-character shard), and requires a `models--` repo
folder. These checks are not security boundaries, since anyone who can
create the layout can also create the marker and names. They do tie ORT
to `huggingface_hub` internals, so a future layout change would break
loading again. I built both and loaded the same synthetic caches:

| Scenario | #33974 | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| Shared store, model and data in different shards | loads | loads |
| Mixed repo-local/shared blobs (both directions) | loads | loads |
| `datasets--…` repo | fails | loads |
| Model folder reached through a symlinked directory | fails | loads |
| Shared store marker version other than `1` | fails | loads |
| Location `../x`; data symlink outside the cache; symlinked `blobs/` |
rejected | rejected |

### Motivation and Context

Fixes #33950. Downstream projects currently work around it by pinning
`huggingface_hub<=1.31`, setting `HF_HUB_DISABLE_SHARED_BLOBS=1`, or
copying files out of the cache.

### Testing

- Real cache: reproduced the issue with `onnxruntime==1.31.1` and
`huggingface_hub==2.4.0` (`onnx-community/sam2.1-hiera-tiny-ONNX`, fresh
`HF_HOME`). With this PR, the same cache loads. The two mixed layouts
created by downloading one of the files with
`HF_HUB_DISABLE_SHARED_BLOBS=1` also fail with 1.31.1 and load with this
PR.
- `onnxruntime_test_all
--gtest_filter='HuggingFaceCachePathValidationTest.*:PathValidationTest.*:GetExtDataFromTensorProtoTest.*'`:
all pass. Without the `tensorprotoutils.cc` change, the 6 tests for
accepted layouts fail. Removing any one of the conditions (no `..`
escape, model in a blob store, `blobs/` folder bound, repo folder name,
symlinked `blobs/`, opened-file check) makes the targeted test fail.
- `python -m pytest
onnxruntime/test/python/onnxruntime_test_python_symlink_data.py`: 4
passed (plus 2 subtests).
- Full `onnxruntime_test_all` on Linux x64 (CPU, Release): 2897 passed.
`lintrunner`: no issues.
- Not run locally: Windows and WASM. The new tests skip when symlinks
cannot be created, and the load test is excluded on WASM like the other
external-file tests in that file.

- [x] Tests added/updated
- [x] No breaking changes
- [ ] Documentation updated (not applicable)

+static bool HasStrictPathComponentPrefix(const std::filesystem::path& prefix, const std::filesystem::path& path) {

+//   2. Every directory traversal step before the leaf stays at non-negative lexical depth relative to `model_dir`

+//      under `model_dir_canonical` (rejecting intermediate directory symlinks including `symlink_dir/..` on both

+static Status IsExternalDataContainedInModelDir(const std::filesystem::path& model_dir,
+                                                const std::filesystem::path& model_dir_canonical,
+                                                const std::filesystem::path& external_data_path,
+                                                bool& is_contained) {
+  is_contained = false;
+  if (external_data_path.empty() || !external_data_path.root_path().empty()) {
+    return Status::OK();
+  }
+
+  const auto combined_leaf = (model_dir_canonical / external_data_path).filename();
+  if (combined_leaf.empty() || combined_leaf == ORT_TSTR(".") || combined_leaf == ORT_TSTR("..")) {
+    return Status::OK();
+  }
+
+  int depth = 0;
+  std::filesystem::path current_dir = model_dir;
+  std::optional<std::filesystem::path> prev_part;
+  for (const auto& part : external_data_path) {
+    if (part.empty() || part == ORT_TSTR(".")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (prev_part.has_value()) {
+      if (*prev_part == ORT_TSTR("..")) {
+        if (depth == 0) {
+          return Status::OK();
+        }
+        --depth;
+      } else {
+        ++depth;
+      }
+      current_dir /= *prev_part;
+      std::filesystem::path current_canonical;
+      ORT_RETURN_IF_ERROR(WeaklyCanonicalPath(current_dir, current_canonical));

+    }

+    const auto parent = revision_dir.parent_path();
+    if (parent == revision_dir) {
+      break;
+    }
+    revision_dir = parent;
+  }
+
+  return false;

{"sha":"2bf400af16424da26e02316491e0e5de519db47e","node_id":"C_kwDOCVq1mNoAKDJiZjQwMGFmMTY0MjRkYTI2ZTAyMzE2NDkxZTBlNWRlNTE5ZGI0N2U","commit":{"author":{"name":"Tianlei Wu","email":"tlwu@microsoft.com","date":"2026-11-13T01:57:03Z"},"committer":{"name":"GitHub","email":"noreply@github.com","date":"2026-11-13T01:57:03Z"},"message":"Fix external data validation for Hugging Face Hub shared blob store (#34099)

### Description

Since `huggingface_hub` 1.32, the Hugging Face Hub cache stores Xet
files once per cache in a [blob store shared across
repos](https://huggingface.co/docs/huggingface_hub/guides/manage-cache#shared-blobs-across-repos)
(`<cache>/blobs/<hash prefix>/<hash>`), and the repo's `blobs/<etag>`
becomes a relative symlink to it. A model and its external data in one
snapshot can then resolve into different folders (for example
`blobs/28/…` and `blobs/d4/…`, or one in the repo's `blobs/` and one in
the shared store). The symlink fallback from #27374 only accepts
external data next to the resolved model, so models with external data
loaded from a default `hf_hub_download` path fail with `External data
path escapes model directory`. This PR teaches both external data
validators about the shared store without trusting anything outside the
cache's blob folders.

### Summary of Changes

#### Validation (`onnxruntime/core/framework/tensorprotoutils.cc`)

New Pass 3 in `ValidateExternalDataPath`, reached only when the model is
a symlink and Passes 1–2 fail. If the canonical model directory is in a
snapshot of a cache repo (`<cache>/<type>s--<repo
id>/snapshots/<revision>/…`, also from a subfolder such as `onnx/`),
external data is accepted when:

1. its path does not leave the model directory before symlinks are
resolved (no `..` escape), and
2. both the model and the external data resolve to files under the blob
stores of that cache: the repo's `blobs/` folder or the cache-wide
`blobs/` folder.

`ValidateOpenedExternalDataPath` applies the same blob-store check to
the canonical path of the opened file, so the opened-file validation
from #33063 also covers the new case. The cost is one extra
canonicalization, and only after the existing passes fail.

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `onnxruntime/core/framework/tensorprotoutils.cc` | Add
`IsInHuggingFaceCacheBlobStores` and use it in both validators. |
| `onnxruntime/test/framework/tensorutils_test.cc` |
`HuggingFaceCachePathValidationTest`: 11 tests on a cache built like
`huggingface_hub` does, with two-hop relative symlinks (6 accepted
layouts, 5 rejected). |
| `onnxruntime/test/python/onnxruntime_test_python_symlink_data.py` |
End-to-end `InferenceSession` test for the shared store and for a mixed
repo-local/shared layout. |

#### Security notes

- Paths are compared in canonical form. A canonical path has no
symlinks, so a file whose canonical path is under `<cache>/blobs` is
stored in that real folder. If a `blobs/` folder is itself a symlink or
junction, nothing matches (`huggingface_hub` also never uses a symlinked
`blobs/` folder as the shared store).
- The model itself must resolve into the blob stores. This rejects
symlinked models that point outside the cache, and `symlink/..` tricks
in the model path.
- The no-`..` requirement keeps a malicious model from reaching other
cached repos' files. In a real cache, the entries of a snapshot folder
are symlinks that `huggingface_hub` creates to files of the same repo.
- Someone who can write into the cache root gains nothing new. With the
existing Pass 2 (for example ORT 1.31.1), they can already make a model
read any blob by putting the model file in the same shard folder
(verified). `huggingface_hub` also gives the store and shard folders the
same permissions as the cache root.
- Unchanged: empty, absolute, and in-memory-tag locations are still
rejected before any fallback, and Passes 1–2 behave as before.

#### Comparison with #33974

#33974 targets the same issue. It also checks the
`.huggingface-shared-blobs` marker (version `1`) and blob names (hex,
40/64 characters, 2-character shard), and requires a `models--` repo
folder. These checks are not security boundaries, since anyone who can
create the layout can also create the marker and names. They do tie ORT
to `huggingface_hub` internals, so a future layout change would break
loading again. I built both and loaded the same synthetic caches:

| Scenario | #33974 | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| Shared store, model and data in different shards | loads | loads |
| Mixed repo-local/shared blobs (both directions) | loads | loads |
| `datasets--…` repo | fails | loads |
| Model folder reached through a symlinked directory | fails | loads |

### Description

Since `huggingface_hub` 1.32, the Hugging Face Hub cache stores Xet
files once per cache in a [blob store shared across
repos](https://huggingface.co/docs/huggingface_hub/guides/manage-cache#shared-blobs-across-repos)

becomes a relative symlink to it. A model and its external data in one
snapshot can then resolve into different folders (for example
`blobs/28/…` and `blobs/d4/…`, or one in the repo's `blobs/` and one in
the shared store). The symlink fallback from #27374 only accepts
external data next to the resolved model, so models with external data
loaded from a default `hf_hub_download` path fail with `External data
path escapes model directory`. This PR teaches both external data
validators about the shared store without trusting anything outside the
cache's blob folders.

### Summary of Changes

#### Validation (`onnxruntime/core/framework/tensorprotoutils.cc`)

New Pass 3 in `ValidateExternalDataPath`, reached only when the model is

snapshot of a cache repo (`<cache>/<type>s--<repo

1. its path does not leave the model directory before symlinks are
resolved (no `..` escape), and
2. both the model and the external data resolve to files under the blob
stores of that cache: the repo's `blobs/` folder or the cache-wide
`blobs/` folder.

the canonical path of the opened file, so the opened-file validation
from #33063 also covers the new case. The cost is one extra

+//   hub/models--org--name/blobs/<data etag>                   -> ../../blobs/d4/d4bb...
